rationale: methodProgram and its declarations use qualified Point.take and Point.copy calls with explicit receiver arguments and the two prefix receiver permissions. The selected conjunction checks typing, execution, p empty and s/t shared aliases before initial exit, and the exit step to an empty terminal state. This covers the surface examples as abstract syntax, without claiming a parser or receiver-call sugar. The machine/gc/steps units introduce the lifetime notation; inherited syntax, storage and typing notation remain in the listed dependency units. Functions keeps its explicit inherited-machinery forward reference to the appendix.
limitations: Abstract syntax formalization, not a parser or elaborator.
GC is a noncomputable mathematical reachability filter. General Functions call-stack safety remains a separate draft.
